mapper.sql: item.id, item.course_id, item.chapter_id, item.cognitive_level_id, level.code AS cognitive_level_code, level.name AS cognitive_level_name, item.content, item.content_format, item.explanation AS question_explanation, item.explanation_format AS question_explanation_format, item.question_type, item.code_runner_contract::text AS code_runner_contract, item.source_type, item.created_by, item.supersedes_bank_question_id, item.version, item.created_at, item.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM edu.question_drafts item LEFT JOIN edu.cognitive_levels level ON level.id = item.cognitive_level_id WHERE item.course_id = #{courseId} AND item.id = #{itemId}
SELECT FROM edu.question_drafts item LEFT JOIN edu.cognitive_levels level ON level.id = item.cognitive_level_id WHERE item.id = #{itemId}
SELECT FROM edu.question_drafts item LEFT JOIN edu.cognitive_levels level ON level.id = item.cognitive_level_id WHERE item.course_id = #{courseId} AND item.id = #{itemId} FOR UPDATE OF item

SELECT , item.origin_draft_id, item.validated_by, item.validated_at FROM edu.question_bank_questions item JOIN edu.cognitive_levels level ON level.id = item.cognitive_level_id WHERE item.course_id = #{courseId} AND item.id = #{itemId}

SELECT , item.origin_draft_id, item.validated_by, item.validated_at FROM edu.question_bank_questions item LEFT JOIN edu.cognitive_levels level ON level.id = item.cognitive_level_id WHERE item.id = #{questionId} OR item.origin_draft_id = #{questionId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, question_draft_id AS question_id, content, content_format, is_correct, explanation, explanation_format, order_index, created_at, updated_at FROM edu.question_draft_answers WHERE question_draft_id = #{itemId} ORDER BY order_index

SELECT id, question_bank_question_id AS question_id, content, content_format, is_correct, explanation, explanation_format, order_index, created_at, updated_at FROM edu.question_bank_answers WHERE question_bank_question_id = #{itemId} ORDER BY order_index
SELECT learning_outcome_id FROM edu.question_draft_learning_outcomes WHERE question_draft_id = #{itemId} ORDER BY learning_outcome_id
SELECT learning_outcome_id FROM edu.question_bank_question_learning_outcomes WHERE question_bank_question_id = #{itemId} ORDER BY learning_outcome_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu.question_drafts item LEFT JOIN edu.cognitive_levels level ON level.id = item.cognitive_level_id
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu.question_draft_learning_outcomes link WHERE link.question_draft_id = item.id AND link.learning_outcome_id = #{learningOutcomeId} )

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu.question_bank_questions item JOIN edu.cognitive_levels level ON level.id = item.cognitive_level_id
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu.question_bank_question_learning_outcomes link WHERE link.question_bank_question_id = item.id AND link.learning_outcome_id = #{learningOutcomeId} )
SELECT id, code, name, sort_order FROM edu.cognitive_levels ORDER BY sort_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu.question_drafts (id, course_id, chapter_id, cognitive_level_id, content, content_format, explanation, explanation_format, question_type, code_runner_contract, source_type, created_by, supersedes_bank_question_id, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{courseId}, #{chapterId}, #{cognitiveLevelId}, #{content}, #{contentFormat, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.richcontent.RichContentFormat, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{explanation}, #{explanationFormat, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.richcontent.RichContentFormat, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{questionType, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.Question$QuestionType, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, CAST(#{codeRunnerContractJson} AS jsonb), #{sourceType, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.questionbank.QuestionBankSourceType, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{createdBy}, #{supersedesBankQuestionId}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE edu.question_drafts SET chapter_id = #{item.chapterId}, cognitive_level_id = #{item.cognitiveLevelId}, content = #{item.content}, content_format = #{item.contentFormat, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.richcontent.RichContentFormat, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, explanation = #{item.explanation}, explanation_format = #{item.explanationFormat, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.richcontent.RichContentFormat, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, question_type = #{item.questionType, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.Question$QuestionType, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, code_runner_contract = CAST(#{item.codeRunnerContractJson} AS jsonb), version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{item.id} AND course_id = #{item.courseId} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu.question_bank_questions (id, origin_draft_id, course_id, chapter_id, cognitive_level_id, content, content_format, explanation, explanation_format, question_type, code_runner_contract, source_type, created_by, validated_by, validated_at, supersedes_bank_question_id, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{originDraftId}, #{courseId}, #{chapterId}, #{cognitiveLevelId}, #{content}, #{contentFormat, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.richcontent.RichContentFormat, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{explanation}, #{explanationFormat, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.richcontent.RichContentFormat, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{questionType, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.Question$QuestionType, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, CAST(#{codeRunnerContractJson} AS jsonb), #{sourceType, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.questionbank.QuestionBankSourceType, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{createdBy}, #{validatedBy}, #{validatedAt}, #{supersedesBankQuestionId}, 0, #{createdAt}, NOW())

INSERT INTO edu.question_draft_answers (id, question_draft_id, content, content_format, is_correct, explanation, explanation_format, order_index, created_at, updated_at) VALUES
(#{answer.id}, #{answer.questionId}, #{answer.content}, #{answer.contentFormat, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.richcontent.RichContentFormat, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{answer.correct}, #{answer.explanation}, #{answer.explanationFormat, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.richcontent.RichContentFormat, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{answer.orderIndex}, NOW(), NOW())

(#{answer.id}, #{answer.questionId}, #{answer.content}, #{answer.contentFormat, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.richcontent.RichContentFormat, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{answer.correct}, #{answer.explanation}, #{answer.explanationFormat, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.richcontent.RichContentFormat, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{answer.orderIndex}, NOW(), NOW())
